<meta charset="utf-8">
<div id="fm-mc">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Roboto+Condensed:wght@300;400;700&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
#fm-mc{--cream:#FFEDDF;--paper:#FBF6F1;--ink:#272727;--mauve:#8C7178;--terra:#C24A22;--suave:#EADFD8;
 font-family:Montserrat,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;overflow:hidden;line-height:1.7;font-size:16px}
#fm-mc *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
#fm-mc .wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px}
#fm-mc .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}
#fm-mc .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
#fm-mc .lbl{font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--terra)}
#fm-mc h1,#fm-mc h2,#fm-mc h3{font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.05}
/* hero */
#fm-mc .hero{position:relative;background:var(--cream);padding:64px 0 70px;overflow:hidden}
#fm-mc .mq{position:absolute;left:0;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.85;pointer-events:none;animation:fmR 34s linear infinite}
#fm-mc .mq.a{top:40px;font-size:150px;color:#fff;opacity:.7}
#fm-mc .mq.b{bottom:18px;font-size:96px;color:var(--terra);opacity:.08;animation-duration:46s}
@keyframes fmR{from{transform:translateX(-50%)}to{transform:translateX(0)}}
#fm-mc .hgrid{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:56% 44%;gap:40px;align-items:center}
#fm-mc .pre{font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;color:var(--terra);margin-bottom:12px;animation:fmUp .8s ease both}
#fm-mc h1{font-family:'Anton',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(46px,6.4vw,86px);letter-spacing:.01em;line-height:.98;margin-bottom:14px;animation:fmUp .9s .1s ease both}
#fm-mc .sub{font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,23px);color:var(--mauve);line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:20px;animation:fmUp .9s .2s ease both}
@keyframes fmUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#fm-mc .meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:22px}
#fm-mc .meta span{font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--suave);border-radius:30px;padding:7px 14px}
#fm-mc .cd{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:24px}
#fm-mc .cd div{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:4px;min-width:68px;padding:9px 6px;text-align:center}
#fm-mc .cd b{display:block;font-family:'Anton',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:28px;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#fm-mc .cd i{font-style:normal;font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--suave)}
#fm-mc .btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--terra);color:#fff;border:0;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:15px;padding:16px 34px;border-radius:2px;animation:fmP 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;transition:transform .2s}
#fm-mc .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
@keyframes fmP{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(194,74,34,.5)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(194,74,34,0)}}
#fm-mc .ph{position:relative;max-width:420px;margin-left:auto}
#fm-mc .ph:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border:2px solid var(--terra);transform:translate(0,0);transition:transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) .4s}
#fm-mc .ph.in:before{transform:translate(18px,18px)}
#fm-mc .ph .fr{position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 26px 60px rgba(92,70,78,.25)}
#fm-mc .ph img{display:block;width:100%;animation:fmKB 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes fmKB{from{transform:scale(1)}to{transform:scale(1.07)}}
#fm-mc .ph .sh{position:absolute;top:-20%;left:-70%;width:40%;height:140%;background:linear-gradient(100deg,transparent,rgba(255,236,214,.35),transparent);transform:rotate(12deg);animation:fmSh 6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes fmSh{0%,60%{left:-70%}100%{left:140%}}
#fm-mc .strip{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;padding:12px 0}
#fm-mc .strip div{display:inline-block;font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12.5px;animation:fmR 30s linear infinite}
/* secciones */
#fm-mc section{padding:70px 0}
#fm-mc .center{text-align:center;max-width:820px;margin:0 auto}
#fm-mc h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.2vw,46px);font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 14px}
#fm-mc .lead{font-size:17.5px;color:#5c534f}
#fm-mc .items{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:38px}
#fm-mc .item{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--suave);border-radius:8px;padding:24px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .7s ease calc(var(--i)*.12s),transform .7s ease calc(var(--i)*.12s),box-shadow .3s}
#fm-mc .items.in .item{opacity:1;transform:none}
#fm-mc .item:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(92,70,78,.14);transform:translateY(-4px)}
#fm-mc .item .n{font-family:'Anton',sans-serif;font-size:40px;line-height:1;color:var(--terra);min-width:54px}
#fm-mc .item h3{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
#fm-mc .item p{font-size:15px;color:#5c534f}
#fm-mc .frase{font-family:'Anton',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,60px);text-align:center;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.01em}
#fm-mc .frase em{font-style:normal;color:var(--terra)}
/* formulario */
#fm-mc .reg{background:var(--paper)}
#fm-mc .card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--suave);border-radius:10px;padding:42px 40px;max-width:720px;margin:34px auto 0;box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(92,70,78,.08)}
#fm-mc .field{margin-bottom:16px}
#fm-mc label{display:block;font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mauve);margin-bottom:6px}
#fm-mc input,#fm-mc select,#fm-mc textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--suave);border-radius:4px;padding:13px 15px;font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;outline:none}
#fm-mc input:focus,#fm-mc select:focus,#fm-mc textarea:focus{border-color:var(--terra)}
#fm-mc .two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
#fm-mc .ok-legal{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:13px;color:#5c534f;margin:6px 0 18px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-family:Montserrat,sans-serif;line-height:1.5}
#fm-mc .ok-legal input{width:auto;margin-top:4px;accent-color:var(--terra)}
#fm-mc .card .btn{width:100%;text-align:center}
#fm-mc .nota{font-size:12.5px;color:#a99e98;text-align:center;margin-top:14px}
#fm-mc .listo{display:none;text-align:center}
#fm-mc .listo h3{font-family:'Anton',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:38px;margin-bottom:8px}
#fm-mc .listo p{color:#5c534f;margin-bottom:16px}
#fm-mc .listo .fila{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
#fm-mc .sec{display:inline-block;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-family:'Roboto Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;background:#fff}
#fm-mc .sec:hover{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
@media(max-width:860px){
 #fm-mc .hero{padding:36px 0 44px}
 #fm-mc .hgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px}
 #fm-mc .ph{order:-1;max-width:290px;margin:0 auto}
 #fm-mc .mq.a{font-size:90px} #fm-mc .mq.b{font-size:60px}
 #fm-mc .cd div{min-width:0;flex:1}
 #fm-mc .items,#fm-mc .two{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 #fm-mc section{padding:50px 0} #fm-mc .card{padding:30px 20px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#fm-mc *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}#fm-mc .rv,#fm-mc .item{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}}
</style>
